title: Mbappé Loses Endorsements, I Build Dashboards
titleZh: 姆巴佩丢代言，我造仪表盘
description: Steven talks about Mbappé losing Chinese endorsements over a meme and the gap between free speech and freedom after speech. He also shows off the comic, video and Substack dashboards he built with Claude Code, and gives an update on office hours, the IELTS partner program and Beijing's late autumn.

sentences.zh: 内容速览
sentences.en: Quick Overview

sentences.zh: 今天这期节目里，史蒂文聊了三件事：法国球星姆巴佩因为一个网络梗丢掉了中国的代言，让他昨晚辗转难眠；他又迷上了AI，用Claude Code做出了带音乐和视频标签页的漫画编辑器，还有一个Substack工作台；最后回到大学，聊聊被记录的坐班时间、没什么人用的雅思搭档计划，以及迟迟不肯变红的北京秋天。
sentences.en: In today's episode, Steven talks about three things: French football star Mbappé lost a Chinese endorsement deal over an internet meme, which kept him tossing and turning last night; he has also gotten hooked on AI, using Claude Code to build a comic editor with music and video tabs, plus a Substack workbench; and finally, back at the university, he talks about tracked office hours, an IELTS partner program that hardly anyone uses, and a Beijing autumn that just won't turn red.

sentences.zh: 可怜的姆巴佩
sentences.en: Poor Mbappé

sentences.zh: 昨晚史蒂文本该早点睡，可跟女朋友通完电话，他刷起微信，发现姆巴佩正被中国的大品牌“拉黑”。
sentences.en: Last night Steven should have gone to bed early, but after he finished a phone call with his girlfriend, he started scrolling through WeChat and found that Mbappé was being "blacklisted" by major Chinese brands.

sentences.zh: 原来他有个外号叫“独裁者”，网上还流传着一组恶搞图，把他的脸换到各种历史人物身上，其中就有毛泽东。
sentences.en: It turns out he has a nickname, "the Dictator," and a set of parody images was circulating online that swapped his face onto various historical figures, including Mao Zedong.

sentences.zh: 有人问他最喜欢哪一张，他选了中国那张，结果中国网友炸了锅。
sentences.en: Someone asked him which one he liked best, and he picked the Chinese one; as a result, Chinese netizens exploded in outrage.

sentences.zh: 在史蒂文看来，这不过是AI换脸的玩笑，姆巴佩或许只想拉近与中国球迷的距离。
sentences.en: In Steven's view, it was just an AI face-swap joke, and Mbappé perhaps only wanted to get closer to his Chinese fans.

sentences.zh: 可惜弄巧成拙，他不得不在Instagram上发声明道歉。
sentences.en: Unfortunately, it backfired, and he had to post an apology statement on Instagram.

sentences.zh: 双重标准与“说完话之后的自由”
sentences.en: Double standards and "freedom after speech"

sentences.zh: 史蒂文转发这篇文章，是因为过去一年中国社交媒体拿别人开玩笑一直乐此不疲。
sentences.en: Steven shared this article because over the past year, Chinese social media has never tired of making fun of other people.

sentences.zh: 有位中国网友把特朗普学得惟妙惟肖，没人叫他“客气点”。
sentences.en: One Chinese netizen did a spot-on impression of Trump, and nobody told him to "be more polite."

sentences.zh: 美国网红IShowSpeed在中国走红，部分原因是一首围绕中文口头禅创作的歌，那个词听起来像另一个意思，他也一笑置之。
sentences.en: American influencer IShowSpeed became popular in China partly because of a song built around a Chinese catchphrase, a word that sounds like it means something else, and he just laughed it off.

sentences.zh: 有人对史蒂文说，嘲笑领导人就像说林肯是奴隶主。
sentences.en: Someone told Steven that mocking a leader is like saying Lincoln was a slave owner.

sentences.zh: 他的回答是：在美国，你可以出版这样的书，还能上电视；在中国做不到。
sentences.en: His answer was: in the US, you can publish a book like that and even go on TV; in China you can't.

sentences.zh: 正如有人所说：“你能保证言论自由，却保证不了说完话之后的自由。”
sentences.en: As someone put it: "You can guarantee freedom of speech, but you can't guarantee freedom after the speech."

sentences.zh: 姆巴佩想重返中国市场，恐怕得像约翰·塞纳那样诚恳道歉。
sentences.en: If Mbappé wants to return to the Chinese market, he'll probably have to apologize as sincerely as John Cena did.

sentences.zh: Claude Code 与仪表盘大爆发
sentences.en: Claude Code and an explosion of dashboards

sentences.zh: 这两周，史蒂文一直在终端里玩Claude Code，常常同时开两三个窗口。
sentences.en: For the past two weeks, Steven has been playing with Claude Code in the terminal, often with two or three windows open at once.

sentences.zh: 它帮他转写文字、整理文件，还提供基于文字稿的仪表盘，方便快速剪视频；它能写Substack文章并配上图片提示词，翻译成中文，再发布到GitHub。
sentences.en: It helps him transcribe text and organize files, and it also provides transcript-based dashboards that make it easy to edit videos quickly; it can write Substack articles with image prompts, translate them into Chinese, and then publish them to GitHub.

sentences.zh: 要是手工来做，每次录完节目还得多花六个小时。
sentences.en: If he did it by hand, each recorded episode would take him an extra six hours.

sentences.zh: 这套工具每月约60美元，他觉得物超所值。
sentences.en: This set of tools costs about 60 US dollars a month, and he thinks it's well worth the money.

sentences.zh: 他给自己定了期限：“如果一年内做不成，那就永远做不成了。”
sentences.en: He gave himself a deadline: "If I can't make it work within a year, I never will."

sentences.zh: 而“做成”的标准是：能赚钱。
sentences.en: And the standard for "making it work" is: it has to make money.

sentences.zh: 漫画、“土味”音乐和自制视频编辑器
sentences.en: Comics, "cheesy" music, and a homemade video editor

sentences.zh: 漫画仪表盘能把习语、搭配和语法点变成漫画，每一幅都藏着一个小知识点。
sentences.en: The comic dashboard can turn idioms, collocations, and grammar points into comics, with a little nugget of knowledge hidden in each panel.

sentences.zh: AI设计的人物阵容很多元，可史蒂文给一位朋友看时，对方却问：“轮椅和彩虹旗呢？”
sentences.en: The AI-designed cast of characters was quite diverse, but when Steven showed it to a friend, the friend asked, "Where are the wheelchair and the rainbow flag?"

sentences.zh: “哎呀，糟糕！”
sentences.en: "Oh no, oops!"

sentences.zh: 于是现在角色更丰富了。
sentences.en: So now the characters are more diverse.

sentences.zh: 漫画需要没有人声的配乐。
sentences.en: The comics need background music without vocals.

sentences.zh: Pixabay可能被YouTube下架，GarageBand自动演奏难听极了，最后他选了Homebrew上的免费软件FluidSynth，能做出“你能想象到的最土的MIDI音乐”，正合适。
sentences.en: Pixabay tracks might get taken down by YouTube, and GarageBand's auto-play sounded awful, so in the end he chose FluidSynth, free software on Homebrew, which can produce "the cheesiest MIDI music you can imagine" — just right.

sentences.zh: 他又加了视频标签页，能改标题、调顺序、选择肯·伯恩斯缩放效果，再导出到Final Cut。
sentences.en: He also added a video tab where you can edit titles, adjust the order, and choose a Ken Burns zoom effect, then export to Final Cut.

sentences.zh: “我一周就自己用AI写出了一个视频编辑器，开什么玩笑？”
sentences.en: "I wrote a video editor myself with AI in one week — are you kidding me?"

sentences.zh: Substack工作台（外加TikTok上的问候）
sentences.en: A Substack workstation (plus greetings on TikTok)

sentences.zh: 没错，他给Substack做了个仪表盘，可Substack本来就是个仪表盘。
sentences.en: That's right, he built a dashboard for Substack, but Substack already is a dashboard.

sentences.zh: 他到底在偷多少懒？
sentences.en: Just how much is he slacking off?

sentences.zh: 问得好。
sentences.en: Good question.

sentences.zh: 里面分草稿、待发布、已发布三栏，能单独改写某一段。
sentences.en: Inside, it's split into three columns—drafts, scheduled, and published—and he can rewrite any single paragraph on its own.

sentences.zh: 他把图片提示词贴进ChatGPT，放进图片就大功告成。
sentences.en: He pastes the image prompt into ChatGPT, drops the image in, and he's done.

sentences.zh: 关键是，播客一录完，文章就已经准备好了。
sentences.en: The key is that as soon as the podcast is recorded, the article is already ready.

sentences.zh: 以前他常在凌晨一点边打哈欠边录音，因为从2021年起，他每天都更新一期。
sentences.en: He used to record at 1 a.m., yawning all the while, because since 2021 he's put out an episode every day.

sentences.zh: TikTok直播里，有人夸他的胡子好看。
sentences.en: During a TikTok livestream, someone complimented his beard.

sentences.zh: 灯光不太理想，但“你上一次因为看不清而退出直播间，是什么时候？”
sentences.en: The lighting wasn't ideal, but "When was the last time you left a livestream because you couldn't see clearly?"

sentences.zh: 坐班时间与雅思搭档计划
sentences.en: Office Hours and the IELTS Partner Plan

sentences.zh: 合同写着每周12节课加六小时坐班，可没人提过，学生要扫二维码记录来找他的时间。
sentences.en: His contract said twelve classes a week plus six hours of office hours, but nobody mentioned that students would have to scan a QR code to log the times they came to see him.

sentences.zh: 再加上四小时备课，第十周还有大约50篇期中作文要批。
sentences.en: Add four hours of lesson prep, and in week ten he also has about fifty midterm essays to mark.

sentences.zh: 所以他不用二维码，嫌它太扫兴。
sentences.en: So he doesn't use the QR code; he finds it too much of a buzzkill.

sentences.zh: 学生在人事部门看得到的腾讯在线表格上报名，每人20分钟，这样他就能凑满一小时。
sentences.en: Students sign up on a Tencent online spreadsheet that HR can see, twenty minutes each, so he can fill up a full hour.

sentences.zh: 雅思搭档计划是这样的：你带一位同学来，两人轮流提问、追问，各四轮。
sentences.en: The IELTS Partner Plan works like this: you bring a classmate, and the two of you take turns asking questions and follow-ups, four rounds each.

sentences.zh: 然后他讲评分标准，多数学生大约在五分。
sentences.en: Then he goes over the scoring criteria; most students are at around a five.

sentences.zh: 来过的学生都说好。
sentences.en: Every student who has come says it's good.

sentences.zh: 可有个学生想带别班的同学来。
sentences.en: But one student wanted to bring a classmate from another class.

sentences.zh: 不行。
sentences.en: No way.

sentences.zh: “我可不是为全校开坐班。”
sentences.en: "I'm not running office hours for the whole school."

sentences.zh: 他只给每周都来的那位学生破了一次例。
sentences.en: He made an exception only once, for the student who came every week.

sentences.zh: 男生、女生与“把作文说出来”
sentences.en: Boys, girls, and "saying your essay out loud"

sentences.zh: 他的物联网班里有大约15个男生、两个女生，男生不肯单独跟女生交流。
sentences.en: His IoT class has about 15 boys and two girls, and the boys refuse to interact with the girls one-on-one.

sentences.zh: 女生们请求别再把她们分给男生。
sentences.en: The girls asked not to be put in groups with the boys anymore.

sentences.zh: 他猜这是高中式的同伴压力。
sentences.en: He guesses this is high-school-style peer pressure.

sentences.zh: 他不会点名，但小组讨论照旧，“因为考试就是这样”。
sentences.en: He won't call on people by name, but group discussions continue as usual, "because that's how the exam is."

sentences.zh: 周五，学生要两人一组口头说出各自的主体段落，录音并转写，然后在课堂上不用AI重写，把自然的口语变成正式的学术写作。
sentences.en: On Friday, students will work in pairs to say their body paragraphs out loud, record and transcribe them, and then rewrite them in class without AI, turning natural speech into formal academic writing.

sentences.zh: 寒风里的绿树
sentences.en: Green trees in the cold wind

sentences.zh: 今早气温四度，风很大。
sentences.en: This morning it was four degrees, and very windy.

sentences.zh: 福建的一位前同事不断发来绝美的秋景照片，而北京有雾霾（这话能说吗？），树叶还是绿的。
sentences.en: A former colleague in Fujian keeps sending stunning photos of autumn scenery, while Beijing has smog (am I allowed to say that?), and the leaves are still green.

sentences.zh: 现在是下午六点，天已经黑了，他还要再花三四十分钟做内容。
sentences.en: It's six in the evening now and already dark, and he still has to spend another thirty or forty minutes making content.

sentences.zh: 今日总结
sentences.en: Today's Summary

sentences.zh: 在中国，一句话可能让你损失数百万；而一个仪表盘，能为你节省好几个小时。
sentences.en: In China, one sentence could cost you millions, while a dashboard can save you hours.

sentences.zh: 在两者之间，史蒂文还在努力让学生们开口交流。
sentences.en: Somewhere in between, Steven is still working hard to get his students talking.

vocab.en: to blacklist; to cut off or ban
to blow up; to cause an uproar
to be too clever by half; to backfire
to toe the line; to follow the rules
to never tire of something enjoyable
to be a buzzkill; to dampen the mood
